name: codex-ad
description: Ad creative skills for ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, Codex, and Claude: product-grounded concepts, static ad generation, and format-guided creative workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Ad concepts, images, and visual format guides
interface.longDescription: Three skills. ad-brainstorm scrapes a single product page, analyzes its real product photography shot by shot, builds an audience map, then generates 100 ad concepts across a 10 format x 10 angle grid, with deterministic validators enforcing grid coverage, unique hooks, and image grounding. ad-maker turns marketing context into platform-aware six-slot static ad prompts, SKU gallery prompt libraries, reference image lists, variants, iteration ladders, deterministic readiness scorecards, and post-generation QA refinement instructions. ad-maker2 is an explicitly invoked experimental alternative using pinned visual-format guides, optional brainstorming from researched briefs, and static generation. Supports ChatGPT and ChatGPT Work through available native browsing, vision, image generation, Python execution, and downloadable artifacts; required validation gates remain enforced.
defaultPrompt: Create a Meta feed conversion ad from this product brief.
Create a 4-6 image Shopee gallery prompt library for this SKU.
